Name: Ferngill Fashion Magazine
Author: mossylichenator
Description:
Have you ever been frustrated by how long it takes to acquire clothing? Sure you can craft clothes on your farm, but your style is limited by what items you're willing to part with.

Instead, let the true you shine through with Ferngill Fashion Magazine's subscription service! We'll send the latest in hot fashion straight to your porch! Unhappy with our service? Unsubscribing is easy! Simply tell us you Never want to be fashionable ever again!

[u][1.1.0] Update:
[/u]Paid subscription plans: For those who want more of a challenge. Weekly, Monthly, and Yearly subscriptions at $3,000, $7.500, and $30,000 respectively[u]
[/u]Added hats![u]

[1.0.0] Details:[/u]
Receive articles of clothing regularly in the mail
Set how often you want your subscription to come in
Select what articles of clothing you want to receive

Note: this mod will not give articles of clothing that are added by other mods (mods that replace existing clothes are fine)

[b][u]Coming Soon![/u][/b]
Subscription Tiers: Customize the range of clothing available!!
Boots [s]and Hats[/s]!
Compatibility with mods that add new clothing
And more!!

Downloads.Description: For those having issues with more recent versions of the mod, the legacy version should at least run.
